title: Leia Organa
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: Unable to escape aboard the rebel transport on Hoth, Princess Leia Organa was forced to flee with Han Solo aboard the Millennium Falcon. Cornered by Darth Vader's Super Star Destroyer, she joined her rebel friends in hiding in the asteroid field before eventually heading to Bespin, where the Empire took her prisoner. Strong-willed and full of fiery passion for the cause, Leia was always ready to fight injustice.
